manuscript_review.joint_gram: Necessary condition and variance refinement sound for the stated pseudo-unitary center and self-dual low objects. All claims remain necessary-condition feasibility only.
manuscript_review.self_duality: Real full low S rows and conjugate-dual S identity imply low self-duality in any realization.
manuscript_review.premodular_scope: FPdim bound is scoped to braided spherical categorifications. No unbraided/general exclusion is asserted.
manuscript_review.literature_checked: Dong–Schopieray arXiv:2407.15955v1, Section5.3, Figures13–15,17,19; the two braided-equivalence-class caveats do not expand fusion-rule list.
manuscript_review.minor_wording_issue: Figure17 includes generalized Ising I_2, FPdim8. Replace table row Ising times pointed rank two with Dimension-eight Ising and generalized-Ising rules, or explicitly mention I_2 alongside that row.
